note: MA DCR state park in Hingham, a former WWII ammunition depot 35 minutes from Boston, with 12 miles of paved bike trails and well-known mountain biking. Water spigots are spread through the park and the dump station is free to campers. Loop roads are tight for big rigs. --Claude
